newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan students clash with police, three hurt.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan students clash with police, three hurt.

text.p: Police fired tear gas and plastic bullets at dozens of university students protesting against the government's austerity economic policies on Wednesday.
At least three students were injured by plastic bullets, witnesses said, but there were no immediate reports of arrests.
The small-scale demonstration saw protesters, their faces hidden by rolled-up shirts, throw rocks and bottles at police near the entrance of Venezuela's largest university.
Such protests are nearly a weekly occurrence near the Central University of Venezuela (UCV) campus, in central Caracas.
